name: Implicit Bipartite via Independent Vertex Cover
description: Replaced the explicit "two distinct operational groups" phrasing with its logical equivalent: a guarantee that there exists a subset of vertices covering all edges while containing no edges. Models relying on keyword pattern matching will fail to realize the graph is bipartite and will likely attempt NP-hard MIS solvers, while models that reason logically will deduce bipartiteness and apply Hopcroft-Karp.
